prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create an ORIGINAL DiggerChain lore painting in Boris Vallejo's classic late-1970s / 1980s heroic fantasy oil-painting style, closely attending to the three supplied VISUAL STYLE references. Image 1 Swords and Serpents: sculptural idealized anatomy, forceful theatrical poses, richly glowing warm flesh, saturated color, silky modeled oil paint, restrained background detail. Image 2 The Vortex: handmade luminous painted color transitions, sinuous shapes, atmospheric ultramarine and violet; do not borrow its nudity or subject. Image 3 Gateway: softly brushed colored atmosphere with crisp chosen focal edges. These images are style references only, NOT edit targets or scene templates. Invent our characters, poses, scene, and composition.
The deliverable must unmistakably read as a traditional painted fantasy paperback cover, not a modern cinematic still or game-engine concept render. Firm simplified silhouettes, heroic contrapposto, smoothly hand-modeled anatomy, broad warm-umber shadows, amber/pearl highlights against deep blue-violet/emerald/crimson masses, hand-brushed lost edges. Painted material and human forms are paramount. No photographic pores, camera depth-of-field/bokeh, movie grading, CGI/PBR surfaces, digital armor greebles, hyper-detailed matte-painting architecture, anime, comic ink, pixel art, text, signature, logo, frame or embedded borders. All people are adults, about 30, with nonsexual clothing.
Same cast in all four illustrations: Adrien is a fair man with short chestnut hair and square jaw; Mara is a brown-skinned woman with long black braids; Niko is an olive-skinned man with dark curls and a short beard; Elise is a fair freckled woman with copper-red shoulder-length hair. Strong idealized heroic physiques, expressive faces and hands, each distinct. Fantasy scenes use simple shaped leather/bronze partial armor, short covered tunics, bracers and boots, exposed arms, navy/rust/forest-green/violet fabrics respectively; keep clothing practical and nonsexual, not full engraved movie plate armor.
Wide HORIZONTAL painting, ideally 2:1 landscape format. Artwork fills the entire image edge to edge. Readable at a small website width, decisive large figures rather than tiny people in an over-detailed landscape.

SCENE 1 — THE ORCHARD STONE. Near-future Belgium, a quiet stone country house in the background, ancient apple tree and deep roots. The four friends have civilian weekend clothes, NOT armor yet: simple rolled-sleeve navy shirt, rust blouse, green shirt and violet shirt, sturdy trousers and boots. Arrange them as a compelling painterly triangular group around a newly unearthed black stone at the lower center. Adrien braces a shovel; Mara kneels and touches a root, Niko leans in behind, Elise turns in wonder. The engraved stone shines with eerie yellow-green inner light that sculpts their hands, arms and faces. The house and orchard are suggested in a few warm ochre and dark green brush masses beneath a violet evening sky. A vivid dramatic OIL PAINTING of a supernatural discovery, emphatically not an orchard photograph or movie shot.
